name: PokeDinner (Eglantine fork)
notes: Fork of Eglantine (itself a fork of Eden), primary focus Pokopia per its own description. Confirmed against the real repo - 6 releases found. Most ship a direct linux-x86_64.AppImage; the newest release (2.7.7) regressed to Windows-only, so installing that specific version will correctly report 'no matching asset' rather than install a broken file.
